message.content:
You are fixing review findings on the trades routes in `server/routes.ts` (TaptPay app, repo /home/runner/workspace, branch `feat/trades-vertical`). The trades route block was added in the most recent commit (aa88522). Make these four targeted edits ONLY in that trades `/api/trades/*` block. Do not touch property routes or any other file.

## Fix I1 (Important) — send-balance must only act on a deposit invoice
In the `POST /api/trades/invoices/:id/send-balance` route: after the existing fetch of the invoice (the variable is `dep`) and its ownership check (`dep.merchantId !== merchantId`), and BEFORE the `balanceCents` is computed, add a guard:
```ts
if (dep.kind !== "deposit") return res.status(400).json({ message: "Balance can only be sent for a deposit invoice" });
```
This prevents a merchant from calling send-balance on a non-deposit invoice (e.g. an already-issued balance/full invoice) and minting a duplicate balance.

## Fix I2 (Important) — quick-invoice POST must ownership-check quoteId
In the `POST /api/trades/invoices` route: after the existing `clientProfileId` ownership check and BEFORE `storage.createJobInvoice(...)`, add a guard that, when a quoteId was supplied, verifies it belongs to this merchant:
```ts
if (parsed.data.quoteId) {
  const linkedQuote = await storage.getQuote(parsed.data.quoteId);
  if (!linkedQuote || linkedQuote.merchantId !== merchantId) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Quote not found" });
}
```
(Use whatever the parsed-body variable is actually named in that route — it may be `parsed.data` or similar; match the existing code. `merchantId` is already in scope from the auth guard.)

## Fix M1 + M2 (Minor) — consistent Zod error messages
Two routes return a generic `{ message: "Invalid" }` on Zod failure instead of the actionable parsed message used everywhere else. Change BOTH to use the parsed error:
- `PUT /api/trades/schedules/:id`
- `POST /api/trades/invoices/:id/mark-paid-external`
Replace `return res.status(400).json({ message: "Invalid" });` with `return res.status(400).json({ message: parsed.error.errors[0].message });` (match the variable name the route's `.safeParse` result is assigned to).

## Verify + commit
1. Run `npm run check` — confirm NO new TypeScript errors from your edits (pre-existing unrelated errors are fine). This is the test that covers these changes (the repo has no DB integration-test harness).
2. Commit ONLY `server/routes.ts`:
```
git add server/routes.ts
git commit -m "fix(trades): send-balance deposit guard, quoteId ownership check, consistent zod errors

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
```
Do NOT run git stash/switch/checkout.

## Report
Append your fix report to /tmp/sdd/task-3-report.md if writable; if /tmp write is denied, include the report inline in your final message. Report MUST include: the exact edits made (with the surrounding context lines so the reviewer can confirm placement), the `npm run check` command + result, and the new commit SHA.

Report back with ONLY (under 12 lines): Status (DONE|BLOCKED|NEEDS_CONTEXT); commit SHA+subject; one-line check result; the 4 fixes confirmed applied; any concern.
